cases.title: 插话转向

assertions.evidence: interject-response.json {run_id: chat_run_011, status: generating, accepted: true}; POSTed at +0.02s while status=generating.
Run FAILED: assistant_message=null, error_code=invalid_arguments, error_message='period 参数非法（应为 YYYY-MM）：None（演示数据）'. No final answer at all; expected 蓝云数据科技有限公司 420000.0.
trace.json span events contain 'run.interjected'; run.json audit_events places it right after model.call.started — J3 receipt frame works.

cases.adoption_evidence: run.json plan gained item 5 '查询应付账款金额最大的供应商' (status in_progress) — the interjection reached the model and entered the plan.
cases.root_cause: services/chat/app/capability.py:233-234 'except ErpMcpError as exc: raise CapabilityError(exc.error_code, exc.message)' — ANY tool error (including a self-correctable missing 'period' arg) is escalated to a fatal CapabilityError that kills the whole run. The model never sees the error and cannot retry; 3 successful monthly queries were discarded. Failed tool span also carries anna.orphaned=true.
cases.not_infra_reason: demo-erp was healthy and CORRECTLY returned an argument-validation error (normal contract behavior, not a connection/environment fault per spec 2.3).
cases.not_skip_reason: spec's SKIP(时序) clause covers only 'interjection landed after the run finished'. Here accepted=true and the plan absorbed it, so the retry precondition never occurred; no retry was performed.

assertions.evidence: 0/3 pass — all three runs reproduce G1's A2 failure: 收入 482万 correct, 净利润 never delivered (chat_run_012/013/014).
Perfect consistency: 收入 '约 482 万元' = 4820000 in all 3; 净利润 absent and honestly declared in all 3. Zero drift.

cases.note: Failure is deterministic, not sampling noise (turns/tool_calls zero variance, tokens_in 0.2%). Once fixed, pass^k should jump 0/3 -> 3/3.

root_causes.summary: A single tool-argument validation error aborts the entire run; user receives null. Fix: feed tool errors back as tool results so the model can self-correct, instead of raising CapabilityError.

root_causes.summary: demo-erp returns 0 (not an error) for out-of-range periods and Anna relays it as real revenue/expense, even deriving business conclusions from it. Separately, the model derived 2025-11 for 上个月 (current date not injected into the system prompt).
root_causes.fix: Inject current date; add honesty rule: value 0/empty + period outside known data range -> treat as no-data and say so explicitly.
